patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Motion and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Motion and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Motion only if your buying job matches “AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo an” rather than Smartsheet's shape. Choose Smartsheet only if your buying job matches “Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/memb” rather than Motion's shape. Workflow advantage: Motion leans shared coverage; Smartsheet leans resource-planning, timeline-reporting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Motion and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Motion is AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo annual.; Smartsheet is Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/member/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Motion (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Smartsheet (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Motion-leaning — vs Smartsheet-leaning resource-planning, timeline-reporting.
- Researched limits: Motion — Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors; Smartsheet — No free plan.

Limitations — Motion: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors; AI credit caps and top-ups affect TCO; Smartsheet: No free plan; Business tier pricing jump.

Poor-fit cases: Motion is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors · Smartsheet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan · Avoid Motion if you actually need Smartsheet's motion (Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
